hypothesis: The authority-none V58 continuous consolidator can remain available through exact atomic-status refresh races and can retain immutable terminal lifecycle evidence without weakening fail-closed handling for stale open evidence or unclassified logic errors.
decision: Retain the exact-message concurrent-refresh retry and resolved-only BRENTOIL freshness exemption, keep the repaired recurring consolidator running, and continue escalating collector-health failures independently. This technical repair has no authority to change live strategy, risk, configuration, or orders.
falsifier: Reject or revise this repair if an unclassified ValueError is retried, a stale open BRENTOIL lifecycle is accepted, the consolidator stops publishing while all required sources remain fresh, generator identity changes without a process restart, or any published authority/live-change contract differs from none/false.
limitations: Two recurring publications do not prove indefinite availability; process and freshness telemetry remain required.
Exact-message classification depends on stable upstream error wording and deliberately does not catch novel failures.
Resolved terminal evidence remains bound to exact profile, fingerprint, run, route, side, and lifecycle identity but does not describe a later lifecycle under the same run.
This repair validates research telemetry availability, not strategy profitability.
